problems.quote: remaining alcohol volume of 80·(3/4) = 60 litres, which corresponds to a new concentration of 60/80 = 75 % of the original 40 %, i.e. 30 %
problems.problem: The replacement formula uses total volume (80) instead of initial alcohol volume (32); the concentration derivation is incorrect.
problems.correction: remaining alcohol volume of 32·(3/4) = 24 litres, giving concentration 24/80 = 30%
problems.verifierReason: Original uses total volume for alcohol; correction uses initial alcohol volume.

problems.quote: equals the numerator of the reduced fraction (a − b) / (a + b) or (a + b) / (a − b) depending on direction
problems.problem: The number of distinct meeting points is not the numerator of those fractions. For same direction it is (a−b)/gcd(a,b); for opposite direction it is (a+b)/gcd(a,b).
problems.correction: equals (a−b)/gcd(a,b) for same direction and (a+b)/gcd(a,b) for opposite direction
problems.verifierReason: Original formula for meeting points is incorrect; correction gives standard (a±b)/gcd(a,b).

problems.quote: When a solid is cut by a plane parallel to its base, the resulting smaller solid is similar to the original
problems.problem: This is true only for pyramids and cones (solids that taper uniformly to a point), not for all solids (e.g., cylinders, prisms).
problems.correction: When a pyramid or cone is cut by a plane parallel to its base, the resulting smaller solid is similar to the original
problems.verifierReason: General statement false; only pyramids/cones yield similar solids when cut parallel to base.

problems.quote: Composite indices such as the Human Development Index (HDI) or the Index of Industrial Production (IIP) are geometric means of normalized sub‑indices.
problems.problem: The Index of Industrial Production (IIP) is not a geometric mean; it is a weighted arithmetic mean (Laspeyres index). Only HDI uses a geometric mean.
problems.correction: Composite indices such as the Human Development Index (HDI) are geometric means of normalized sub‑indices; the Index of Industrial Production (IIP) is a weighted arithmetic mean.
problems.verifierReason: IIP is a Laspeyres (weighted arithmetic) index, not a geometric mean; HDI uses geometric mean since 2010. Correction is accurate.
